decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 14 July 2018, the proposal as shown on the drawing submitted 17/07/2018 and numbered 45PR_PL(000), 30PC_PL(001), 30PC_PL(002), 30PC_PL(003), 30PC_PL(004), 30PC_PL(005) and 45PR_PL(Location); and as verified on site was not lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The proposal is unlawful because the property is subject to the following permitted development restrictions: Condition 4 of the original planning permission under which the property was constructed ref. 00096/B/P27 which removes permitted development for extensions. The conditions reads:
Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Development Order) 1977, or any subsequent legislation, no further extension or additions shall be constructed without the prior permission of the Local Planning Authority. 
This condition removed permitted development rights relating to the enlargement of the property. Accordingly, planning permission will be required for the proposed development.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for erection of a single storey rear extension
